messages:
emma: FYI — Planned maintenance tonight for az29 23:30-01:30 UTC. Scope: NIC microcode + staggered GPU soft reboots across 3 cohorts. Primary constraint: az29 has limited egress to APAC, so backfill must prefer local warm pools. Expect brief KV reseed and some cold-cache hits.

raj: Cohorts? timing?

emma: 3 cohorts: Cohort A (2 racks) at 23:30, Cohort B (2 racks) at 23:45, Cohort C (2 racks) at 00:00. 15m gaps to allow metrics to settle.

emma: Runbook key points:
- 22:50 UTC: merge manifest PR (HPA min+1, transient cooldown 6m, relax PDB)
- 23:10 UTC: pre-provision local warmpool (2 nodes/rack) and protect them from spot reclaim for window
- 23:20 UTC: ap-south canary preheat (1 rack) to validate kv hit-rate and routing fallback
- At cohort start: cordon -> kvseed preheat -> confirm kv hit-rate >= 70% OR wait max 12m -> drain -> nic swap -> uncordon
- routing: short announce-suppression 90s per TOR swap; smart-routing will prefer eu-central/us-west for new sessions if az29 withdraws

raj: kvseed snippet (controlplane):
```
./tools/kvseed --region=az29 --cohort=A --concurrency=5 --target-hit=0.70 --ttl=1800
kubectl cordon gpu-az29-01 && kubectl drain gpu-az29-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=60
```

tom: Dedicated pools?

emma: Dedicated hosts labeled dedicated=true will be excluded. Only pool=shared-gpu-az29 is in-scope. No forced restarts for Dedicated unless emergency.

yuki: Cost/backfill plan? if warmpool fails and we need on-demand?

finance-bot: Ops buffer remaining: $3,200. Typical 2-rack on-demand backfill for 1hr estimated $1.0k-$1.8k. Tag any emergency spend with "az29-nic-maint".

emma: We'll try to use local warmpool first; spot fallback only if pre-provision can't hit targets. Emergency on-demand cap set to $2k without manual approval. Raj, can you own warmpool provisioning?

raj: Yep. I'll pre-provision and add transient instance protection. Also will deploy a billing tag lambda.

yuki: Monitoring/rollback criteria: abort and roll back if p95 > 260ms for 5m OR error rate delta > 2.5% for 5m OR kv hit-rate doesn't reach 70% within 12m preheat per cohort.

emma: Agreed. Also temporarily bump HPA floor +1 and set cooldown to 6m to avoid autoscaler thrash. Increase PDB eviction allowance by 1.

ops-bot: [scheduled] Maintenance ticket INF-2026-501 created. Window: 2026-07-01T23:30:00Z - 2026-07-02T01:30:00Z. Pager rotations: infra/eng-sre.

tom: I'll monitor metrics and post kv hit-rate + p95 snapshots at each cohort boundary. If net egress to APAC looks saturated, call abort and we'll shift backfill to local warmpools only.

emma: Final checklist before 22:50 UTC:
- PR merged (HPA/PDB/cooldown)
- warmpool pre-provisioned and protected
- ap-south canary validated (hit-rate >= 70%)
- billing tag lambda deployed

emma: Ping @oncall at first sign of tail latency drift. Good luck night crew :headphones:
